changes.text: 二年三月，大军次肃州。五月，西征将领锦棠（传记只称其名，与左宗棠是两个人；后来左宗棠奉诏入都时由他接替）北逾天山，会金顺军先攻乌鲁木齐，克之；原先窜处乌鲁木齐、仍隶帕夏的白彦虎遁走托克逊。九月，克玛纳斯南城，北路平，乃规南路。

In the third month of the second year the army reached Suzhou. In the fifth, Jintang — a commander of the expedition (the biography gives only his given name; he is a different person from Zuo Zongtang) who would later replace Zuo when Zuo was summoned to the capital — crossed the Tianshan northward, joined Jin Shun's force, and took Ürümqi first; Bai Yanhu, who had been lodged in Ürümqi and still answered to Pasha, fled to Toksun. In the ninth month the southern city of Manas fell. The north was pacified; the plan turned south.
关于争论如何收场，传记记得很简短。军机大臣文祥独赞同左宗棠之议，遂决策出塞，不罢兵，授左宗棠钦差大臣督军事，金顺副之。传记只记文祥一人赞成，未记其理由。

The record of how it ended is brief. Wenxiang, a Grand Council minister, was the only one to favor Zuo's plan; the decision went to march beyond the pass rather than halt the campaign, with Zuo named Imperial Commissioner for military affairs and Jin Shun as his deputy. The biography records only that Wenxiang agreed, and no reason why.

仗打赢之后，外部的看法也变了。国家承平久，武备弛不振，而海外诸国争言富强，虽中国屡平大难，仍私议以为脆弱；及左宗棠平帕夏，外国乃稍稍传说之。京师民间另有一则传言：左宗棠初入京师时，内城有教堂高楼俯瞰宫殿，民间讙言「左侯至，樓即毀矣」；后出示谕晓，传言乃止，原文未明言示谕者是谁。传记以「其威望在人如此」收束此事，随即转笔：左宗棠在军机、译署任上（此职系入觐后所授，传记记于前文），「同列頗厭苦之」，他本人也「自不樂居內，引疾乞退」。

After the victories, opinion abroad shifted. The empire had been at peace so long that its armaments had gone slack, while the overseas powers vied with one another in talk of wealth and power; even though China had put down one great crisis after another, they still privately judged it frail. Once Zuo had dealt with Pasha, the foreigners began to spread the word about him. Within the capital there was a separate, domestic rumor: when Zuo first entered the capital, a church tower in the Inner City overlooked the palace, and people in the city said the tower would come down once the Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain, and the talk stopped. The record does not say who issued the notice. The biography closes the episode by calling it a measure of his prestige, then turns: in his posts at the Grand Council and the foreign-affairs office (conferred after his audience, as the biography records earlier), his colleagues found him a great trial, and Zuo himself, unhappy serving in the capital, pleaded illness and asked to retire.
仗打到这一步，可以停了的声音第二次出现。库伦大臣上言，西事宜画定疆界；廷臣也说西征费钜，乌鲁木齐、吐鲁番既然到手，可以休兵。左宗棠叹道：「今時有可乘，乃為畫地縮守之策乎？」他抗疏争之，上以为然。

The call to stop came a second time. The minister at Kulun reported that the western question should be settled by fixing a frontier, and courtiers argued the expedition cost too much: with Ürümqi and Turpan in hand, the army could rest. Zuo sighed: "The moment offers an opening — and we would settle for drawing lines on the map and shrinking back?" He sent up a forceful memorial against it; the throne agreed.
还有一层分寸。时俄方与土耳其战，金顺请乘虚袭伊犁，左宗棠说：「不可。師不以正，彼有辭矣。」随后大军还定乌什，收南疆东四城，何步云以喀什汉城降；伯克胡里既纳白彦虎，乃效力攻汉城，大军至，复遁走俄；西四城相继下，左宗棠露布以闻，诏晋二等侯。

There was also the matter of restraint. Russia was then at war with Turkey, and Jin Shun asked leave to strike Ili while it lay open. "No," said Zuo. "An army that does not act by right hands them their excuse." The army turned back to reduce Ushi, then took the four eastern cities of the south, and He Buyun surrendered the Chinese city of Kashgar. Bokhuli, having taken in Bai Yanhu, then threw his strength against that Chinese city; when the army arrived, he fled again into Russia. The four western cities fell in turn; Zuo announced the victory by public dispatch, and an edict raised him to second-class marquis.
南北既复，问题从打不打换成怎么守。四年正月，左宗棠条上新疆建行省事宜，并请与俄议还伊犁、交叛人二事。诏遣全权大臣崇厚使俄，俄以通商、分界、偿款三端相要，崇厚遽定约，为朝士所纠，议久不决。

With north and south recovered, the question shifted from whether to fight to how to hold. In the first month of the fourth year Zuo laid out plans to make Xinjiang a regular province and asked that Russia be negotiated with over two things: the return of Ili and the surrender of fugitives. A plenipotentiary envoy, Chong Hou, was sent to Russia. Russia pressed three demands — trade, boundaries, indemnity — and Chong Hou signed at once. Court officials impeached him, and the matter stayed open for a long time.

dispositions.rationale: 在 story.3 锦棠首次出现处，中英文都加注“传记只称其名，与左宗棠是两个人”。其余叙述句中以名称呼左宗棠之处一并改为“左宗棠”：story.2 的“独善宗棠议”改为“独赞同左宗棠之议”，analysis.4 的“及宗棠平帕夏”改为“及左宗棠平帕夏”。英文原本已用 Zuo/Jintang 区分，只补了同样的说明，其余文字不变。

evidence.quote: 詔宗棠入都備顧問，以錦棠代之
